name: robots/cxy1997__robotiq-ur5
title: UR5 with Robotiq 85 gripper (MuJoCo scene)
intro: UR5 with Robotiq 85 gripper (MuJoCo scene), adapted from cxy1997/robotiq-ur5. It reads `time_ms`, `qpos`, `qvel`, `ctrl` and 4 more; runs `step` and `reset`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
